title: Read my calendar
summary: The person's own calendar on this device, read only: what is on today, tomorrow, this weekend or this week. Only when calendar access is already on; it never asks.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks what is on their calendar or schedule, or whether they are free at a time.

arguments.name: when
arguments.description: today, tomorrow, weekend or week; empty for today and tomorrow

_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the Calendar applet for the agent, read only. Writing an event is a later, approved step.
